lines.text: After Samuel died, David went to the Wilderness of Paran, where a wealthy man named Nabal lived with his wife Abigail.
David sent ten young men to Nabal at Carmel to greet him and ask for whatever he could spare.
Nabal asked who David was and refused, so David told his men to strap on their spears.
Abigail loaded donkeys with food and told Nabal nothing, then met David in a ravine and bowed at his feet.
Nabal's heart failed him the next morning, and about seven days later the LORD struck him dead, and Abigail became David's wife.
